title: Truck faults
historyHint: These are recorded events. Which faults are still active has not been confirmed.
incomplete: The available history is incomplete. Missing records or a removed logger entry do not prove a healthy or repaired ECU.
boundsHint: Optional inclusive source message IDs. Each request reads a bounded window; older diagnostic records may require another page.
invalidBounds: Enter positive numeric message IDs, with the start no greater than the end.
unavailable: Faults cannot be loaded right now. Please try again.
incompatible: The received data could not be read. The truck condition has not been confirmed.
empty: No decoded faults in the loaded records
emptyHint: This does not confirm that the truck is fault-free. You can view older records or request a check.
statusHint: This is a historical record. Removing a record does not confirm a repair or a resolved fault.
readHint: You can request an additional fault report. Receiving a response may take time.
fleetUnavailable: A new truck check is unavailable. Recorded faults remain visible.
branchError: Access for a check could not be loaded.
disabled: A new truck check is currently unavailable.
operationsError: The check status cannot be loaded. Refresh the result before trying again.
submissionUncertain: It is unclear whether the check started. Refresh the result; we will not repeat it automatically.
noRequests: No saved check for this truck in the selected branch.
pendingHint: An existing check has not finished. Wait for a response and refresh the result.
noObservations: No matching report or eData acknowledgement observed yet.
nackHint: 154,0 is a negative acknowledgement / device error. It does not mean an empty fault logger.
positiveAckHint: 154,1 is a positive special acknowledgement. It does not itself contain a fault report or prove a completed ECU scan.
reportHint: A diagnostic report was received. Refresh the faults list to review the available records. This does not confirm a complete truck check.
noReportHint: No report was received before the waiting period ended. The fault condition has not been confirmed.
unknownHint: It is unclear whether the check started. It will not be repeated automatically.
readFailedHint: The check could not be completed. This is not a reported vehicle fault.
faultCount: Reported faults in the displayed records
clickHint: Select a fault to see what it means and what to do next.
unreadableHint: Some diagnostic records could not be decoded. They may contain additional fault information.
nextStep: Contact your service team and provide the fault and event time. The service team needs to establish the specific cause.
mechanicalResponse: The system is not responding as expected or is out of adjustment.
unknownCause: A problem was reported, but the specific cause was not identified.
aboveNormal: A value above the normal operating range was reported.
unknownMeaning: The truck reported a fault code for which a verified description is not yet available.
unknownSystem: The affected component has not been identified. The code is preserved in technical details for the service team.
descriptionHint: The system name and failure type are general code references, not a confirmed cause or service diagnosis.
communicationReportHint: Device connection information was received. It does not contain a list of truck faults.
